verdict.rationale: Braintrust's docs say its Loop agent can build dashboards, and that monitoring can be configured via MCP. Traces capture latency, token usage and metadata, and online scoring produces eval scores on production traces, so the raw metrics for such dashboards exist. However, dashboards appear only as a passing mention, with no first-party documentation of a custom dashboard builder or charting over these specific metrics. Missing for 10: dedicated dashboard-building docs (custom charts, grouping, filters), explicit error-rate and cost metrics, any independent or hands-on corroboration of dashboards.
